==Stats==
:[[Blunt damage]]: 19-35 (Requires 9 [[Hammer Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15%
:[[Energy]] -5
:Lengthens [[Weakness]] duration on foes by 33% (Stacking)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Marble Hammer]] [[dye]]d black.
